title: Save safely
summary: Save updates directly, export duplicate copies, revert changes, and prevent accidental data loss.

sections.heading: Saving Modifications
sections.text: Saving writes your annotations and edits into the document. Save As creates an independent duplicate.

sections.heading: Unsaved Edits Confirmation
sections.text: Closing the window with unsaved edits displays a prompt offering Don't Save, Cancel, or Save.

steps: Select File > Save or press Ctrl + S to update the current file.
Select File > Duplicate / Save As New Copy... or press Ctrl + Shift + S for a new file.
Select File > Revert to Original... to discard all session modifications and reload the file.
note: The prompt lets you press Alt + D to discard changes or Enter to save safely.
